honest_disclaimer: On this specific instrument-holdout split, real+augmented beat the persistence baseline. Consistent with train_v3_augmented.py's and experiments/audit_v3/FINAL_REPORT.md's prior findings: this dataset's real drift signal is small relative to measurement uncertainty at ~30 rows/instrument, and augmentation does not reliably outperform simple persistence.
